says: SE's start report: its version, what it loaded with links into the documentation, each component's loaded and newest version, and the one update command.
message:
SE {version} started
[{skills} skills]({skills_page})
[{rules} rules]({rules_page})
[{subagents} sub-agents]({subagents_page})
[Documentation]({docs})

| component | loaded | newest |
|---|---|---|
{components}

{update}

update.due_next: To update: /se:update. The next SE release brings {names}.
update.unknown: Newest versions not read yet; the next start shows them.

version.description: The version of the SE that runs, as its se.toml names it.

skills.description: How many skills loaded, guidance notes aside.

skills_page.description: The documentation's page that lists the skills.

rules.description: How many rules are in force: the rule book's and every guidance note.

rules_page.description: The documentation's page that lists the rules.

subagents.description: How many sub-agents loaded: every agent but SE.

subagents_page.description: The documentation's page that lists the sub-agents.

components.description: SE first, then SE's required components with the version that answered at this start (none where one did not load), then every component of the project's tree, nested ones included, but one a required row shows: its name, the version loaded and the newest release.

update.description: From the table's rows alone (docs/boot.md "The start report"): stopped where a required row did not load; else next where a row SE locks is behind its newest release, due where another row is, due_next where both are; else unknown where a newest version is not read; else current.

names.description: What the case names: the required components that did not load, or each row SE locks that is behind, with its newest release (`kern 2.2.0 and obs 10.4.0`); empty for the other cases.
